prediction_time: After current charge, before current discharge capacity is measured

availability.observed_cycle_number: Requires recorded operating history; counts observed groups, not guaranteed physical cycles
availability.elapsed_days: Days from first recorded test; available from timestamps, not factory age
availability.previous_soh_reference_pct: Requires a previous completed capacity measurement and recorded reference; not automatically available from voltage/current alone
availability.previous_capacity_age_observed_cycles: Recorded cycle groups since the last valid capacity measurement; known before prediction
availability.charge_voltage_mean_v: Recorded current charging session; sample-weighted mean
availability.charge_current_mean_a: Recorded current charging session; sample-weighted mean
availability.charge_duration_approx_s: Recorded current charging session; approximate sampled duration

excluded_columns.previous_capacity_ah: Redundant with prior relative SOH and reference capacity
excluded_columns.reference_capacity_ah: Used to define relative health; omitted as a cell-constant predictor
excluded_columns.charge_voltage_max_v: Controlled upper-voltage limit; little independent variation
excluded_columns.charge_current_max_a: Transient maximum; omit from initial simple feature set
excluded_columns.discharge_c_rate: Future discharge protocol; use for coverage reporting, not as an input unless known in advance
excluded_columns.delivered_capacity_ah: Current discharge capacity directly defines the target
excluded_columns.soh_reference_pct: Current health target, not a same-cycle predictor
excluded_columns.remaining_observed_cycles_to_80pct: Future life target, not an SOH predictor
